title: Graetz problem, pipe (axisymmetric): exact two-mode solution WITH axial conduction (eigenvalues by mpmath) and the fully developed uniform-wall-flux solution with its closed-form Nusselt number; Robin-wall modes (Bi = 2)
physics: u = 2(1 - r^2) e_z, a = 2, kappa = 1/8 (Pe = 16); T = R_1(r) e^{-lam_1 z} - (1/2) R_2(r) e^{-lam_2 z} (Dirichlet wall; and a Robin wall with Bi = 2); uniform flux: T = z/2 + g(r), Nu = 48/11

parameters.boundary_conditions: modes: z = 0 Dirichlet (the exact series), r = 1 Dirichlet T = 0, axis natural, z = 2 exact diffusive flux; uniform flux: z = 0 Dirichlet (exact), r = 1 Neumann q_out = -a A U_m R / 2 = -1/2 (heating), axis natural, z = 2 exact diffusive flux; Robin modes: as the modes with -kappa dT/dr = h T on r = 1, h = 2 kappa
parameters.dirichlet_data: P2 (P1) Lagrange NODAL interpolation of the fixed callables at the vertices and edge midpoints of the Dirichlet boundary parts; at a node shared by two Dirichlet parts the data agree (one exact callable per field); Dirichlet beats every natural condition at a shared node
parameters.supg: Residual-based SUPG: add sum_K int_K tau_K (a b.grad v) R_K(T_h) (r-weighted in axisymmetry) to the Galerkin form, with the FULL element residual R_K(T) = a b.grad T - div(kappa grad T) - s evaluated element-wise (second derivatives of T_h for P2, the grad kappa. grad T term, and in axisymmetry the hoop term kappa T_r / r). FIXED FAMILY: tau_K = C tau_rule(h_K) with tau_coth(h) = h / (2 p a |b|) (coth Pe - 1/Pe), Pe = a |b| h / (2 p kappa), or tau_Shakib(h) = [(2 p a |b| / h)^2 + 9 (4 p^2 kappa / h^2)^2]^(-1/2) (C multiplies tau; it is NOT inside Pe or h); p the element degree; |b| the Euclidean norm of the advecting velocity (in axisymmetry its MERIDIONAL part (b_r, b_z)); tau evaluated at the quadrature points or as an element constant; h_K a length that depends on the element's GEOMETRY only (invariant under a renumbering of its vertices and under rigid motions); admissible pairs (C, h_K): c_adv = C h_K / sqrt(2|K|) in [1/2, 2] AND c_diff = C h_K^2 / (2|K|) in [1/2, 2] (the advective- and diffusive-limit tau relative to C = 1, h_K = sqrt(2|K|)), evaluated on the right isosceles triangles of the unit, channel, pipe and annulus families; the same (rule, C, h_K) is used on every fixed mesh; on the distorted family the per-element values may leave the box (longest edge x 1: c_diff in [1.37, 3.07]), immaterial for its Pe 1e6 items (advective limit: only c_adv matters). Examples: h_K = sqrt(2|K|) (NGSolve mesh_size; MFEM sqrt(T->Weight()) on an affine triangle) with C in [1/2, 2]; the longest edge (sqrt(2) sqrt(2|K|) on the fixed right triangles) with C in [1/(2 sqrt 2), 1] (C = 1 is the library's shakib_hK); MFEM GetElementSize(e, 0) = 1.0746 sqrt(2|K|) with C in [0.47, 1.73].
parameters.quadrature_requirement: Every Galerkin and SUPG integrand that is a polynomial on affine triangles is integrated EXACTLY: for P2 T and v: a b.grad T v with b in P1 degree 4 planar / 5 axisymmetric; with b = u_h in P2 (the coupled energy equation: B, C1, E1, H1, X1) or the quadratic Poiseuille b (G1, G2) degree 5 planar / 6 axisymmetric (a degree-4 rule for a u_h.grad T v moves X1 by 3.4e-8 against its 1e-8 recipe); the momentum terms as F2a requires. Non-polynomial data (MMS loads, Robin T_ext, Neumann data) by rules of degree >= 6 on elements and edges; the identities that involve such data are then QUADRATURE-LIMITED (worst measured 1.3e-11 with an admissible degree-6 rule, against bounds of 1e-10). Data callables are evaluated at interior quadrature points and at the Dirichlet nodes only (some axisymmetric loads have removable 1/r singularities on the axis).

channel.construction: scalar_transport_check.box_mesh(8, 16, k, (0, 1, 0, 2)), k = 0..4: (r, z) in [0,1] x [0,2], 8 x 16 squares of side 1/8, flipped corner cells, red-refined k times. Nested.

parameters.wall_flux: variational outward flux through the closed wall (Dirichlet T = 0): scalar_transport_check.flux_from_residual with v_wall = the P2 nodal function 1 at every wall node (corner nodes included), 0 at every other node; reference scalar_transport_check.graetz_wall_flux_exact
parameters.nusselt: scalar_transport_check.nusselt_uniform_flux: D q_in / (kappa (T_w - T_b)), T_b flow-weighted over the domain, T_w the wall mean, D = 2R (pipe) or 4H (plates)
